definitions.explanation: A shop that sells ready-made dishes and side dishes for home consumption. These shops are a common feature of Japanese shopping streets, department store basements, and supermarkets, offering a wide variety of cooked foods from croquettes to simmered vegetables.

examples.japanese: お{惣菜屋|そうざいや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦コロッケ→コロッケ：10857_korokke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought croquettes at the deli.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{惣菜屋|そうざいや}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{混|こ}んでいる→混む：02574_komu⟧。
examples.english: The deli in front of the station is always crowded.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{疲|つか}れた→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、お{惣菜屋|そうざいや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{夕飯|ゆうはん}→夕飯：02981_yuuhan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかず→おかず：08272_okazu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{何品|なんぴん}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: On days when I'm tired from work, I buy a few side dishes from the deli on the way home for dinner.

notes:
The polite prefix お is almost always attached in everyday speech; {惣菜屋|そうざいや} without お sounds somewhat blunt. The word combines ⟦{惣菜|そうざい}→惣菜：05827_souzai⟧ (side dishes, prepared foods) with ⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ (shop, store).

These shops are deeply embedded in Japanese daily life, particularly in ⟦{商店街|しょうてんがい}→商店街：09391_shoutengai⟧ (shopping streets) and the basement food floors (⟦{デパ地下|でぱちか}→デパ地下：08828_depachika⟧) of department stores. They cater to busy households and single people who want home-style cooking without cooking themselves.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{惣菜屋|そうざいや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy at a deli
- ⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{惣菜屋|そうざいや}: neighborhood deli
- お{惣菜屋|そうざいや}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧: deli bento box

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{惣菜|そうざい}→惣菜：05827_souzai⟧: prepared side dishes — the food itself, not the shop
- ⟦{総菜|そうざい}→総菜：16739_souzai⟧: same word, alternate kanji
- デリ: deli — English loanword, used for Western-style delicatessens
- ⟦{弁当屋|べんとうや}→弁当屋：28445_bentouya⟧: bento shop — specializes in boxed lunches specifically
